title: bromus mollis f. simplicissimus
intro: Bromus mollis f. simplicissimus, commonly known as soft brome, is a subspecies of the soft brome plant, which is a type of perennial grass. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Bromus mollis f. simplicissimus include its anti-inflammatory and anti-diarrheal properties, which make it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
